Practical AI Strategies for Small Business Owners

How can small businesses use AI in practical ways that create real value? In this Paychex THRIVE podcast episode, Entrepreneur Jason Feifer joins host Gene Marks to discuss practical AI strategies for small business owners, including how to identify broken processes, test useful AI applications, and look for opportunities to improve productivity. Learn why businesses don’t need to adopt every new AI tool, how everyday pain points can uncover valuable use cases, and why focused experimentation can be more useful than starting with the technology itself. The conversation also explores AI adoption challenges, real-world examples of AI ROI, and data privacy concerns. Learn more about AI for small businesses, or explore Paychex WISE to see how Paychex is applying AI across workforce operations.
